messages:
Maria Patel: FYI I opened a PR to expand the region availability page with APAC notes + a short data residency callout. asking for docs + legal + eng review. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/2417 :wave:

Raj Kumar: skimmed it, looks solid. had one wording nit under 'data residency' — we shouldn't promise full data residency unless customer opts for Private. suggest: 'Data processed in-region when available; for guaranteed residency use Private deployments.'

Maria Patel: good catch. i'll swap that sentence. also added a brief migration note for customers moving from hosted -> dedicated (billing/keys section).

Linh Tran: can we include an SDK snippet showing how to pin a region in the client? product wants a copy-paste example for python + node. current draft only mentions config in prose.

Maria Patel: yep adding snippets now. thinking: show `region` parameter and example fallback policy. e.g.:
```python
from redwood import RedwoodClient
client = RedwoodClient(api_key=..., region="ap-southeast-1")
resp = client.generate("Summarize this...")
```
and node: 
```js
import Redwood from 'redwood-client'
const client = new Redwood({ apiKey: process.env.RW_KEY, region: 'ap-southeast-1' })
const r = await client.generate('Summarize this...')
```

Sophie Chen: tiny UX ask — add a note about region fallback ordering and default behavior (hosted will route to nearest region unless customer pins). Also add link to routing policy doc (internal link).

Maria Patel: adding fallback paragraph and linking to /docs/routing-policies. also flagging legal to check 'processed in-region when available' language.

doc-ci: docs build succeeded for PR #2417 (linux, mac) — 12 files changed.

Raj Kumar: LGTM besides the earlier phrasing. one more: the table listing 'Available regions' should include 'AP-SOUTHEAST-1 (Singapore) — partial residency' rather than 'available'.

Maria Patel: updated table cell to 'Available (no guaranteed residency)' and added footnote linking to Private options.

Linh Tran: snippets look good. Can we also add a minimal curl example showing header `x-redwood-region`? lots of customers use curl for quick testing.

Maria Patel: added curl example and a short migration tip for SDK v2 -> v3 (region param moved from client options to request-level in some cases). asked eng-runtime to confirm behavior.

Sophie Chen: I'll ping legal once more after your edits.

Maria Patel: thanks everyone — i'll wait for legal sign-off then merge. Planning to land after 2pm PT if no objections. :calendar:

doc-ci: link-checker: 2 broken internal links found in PR — /docs/region-map (old slug) and /tutorials/old-migration.

Maria Patel: fixing links now. changed to /docs/region-availability and /guides/migration-hosted-to-dedicated.

Raj Kumar: nice. please also add a short note under 'limitations' about latency SLAs varying by region for hosted customers.

Maria Patel: added SLA row and called out 'dedicated recommended for strict latency/regulatory needs'.

Sophie Chen: legal ok with the adjusted wording. you can merge once CI is green.

Maria Patel: merging now. thanks! :tada:
